news.title: Key talking points from Sonia Bompastor's pre-Everton press conference
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托在埃弗顿赛前新闻发布会上的主要谈话要点
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor faced the media at Cobham ahead of our Women's Super League clash against Everton on Saturday, and here are the key talking points from what the Blues head coach said. We remain unbeaten this season after 13 matches, but Bompastor assured that the standard of preparation will be as high as always as we head into our fifth WSL game of the campaign at Stamford Bridge. The head coach reported that Lauren James will be missing until the end of this block of matches before the international break, after a scan confirmed that she sustained a hamstring injury during the 6-0 win over Charlton last weekend. Lexi Potter, meanwhile, is available again. Here are the rest of the key talking points from our head coach’s pre-match press conference on Friday. 'My role is to make sure that when we are in good form, we don't go too high. And sometimes when things are not going the way we want, we don't go too low either. I'm responsible for that. 'Right now, of course, we are happy with the results and most of the performances we are having on the pitch, but we won't change anything. We keep working hard, we keep the same mentality, we train with intensity, and we come into every game as well prepared as we can. 'That's what we need to do. Every game in this league is so important and so difficult, so we need to make sure we sustain that for as long as possible.' 'It's always difficult to score goals against any team. The difference maybe in the Charlton game was that we scored early on the game, and we were winning 4-0 after 19 minutes. And when you are really efficient and clinical from the beginning, it changes the whole game. 'Going into the game tomorrow, we are expecting it might not be possible for us to achieve. They are a really difficult team to break down, and we will have to play at our best if we want to get a result from the game. We'll try our best to break them down, to score as early as possible in the game and to see how they react. 'They haven't conceded many goals, and they are an aggressive team, but in a good way. They had a good result against Manchester United, so I'm sure they are coming in with confidence as well. We are very much aware of the threats and the quality this Everton side has, especially in terms of the defensive aspects.' 'It's really important to be hungry. The hunger is part of the mentality and the mindset a team have, and that's what makes the difference between the good teams and the great teams, the ones who are able to win trophies. 'Sometimes you don't always play the best football, but you always find a way to win games, and that's really important. We focus a lot on the quality of the performance we want to put on the pitch, but some days it's not always possible for different reasons. We need to make sure when those days come, we have that hunger and that mentality to turn things around even when it's not the way we want to play.' 'Ellie has been starting her actions higher up the pitch for sure, and also she probably feels more freedom to attack. She's been working really hard in training sessions, and she stays at the end to do some extra work around finishing in the box, crosses, the quality of the crosses, scanning, and the quality of her first touch. 'She's always keen to work hard, and she always asks for extras. She's been doing that from the beginning of the season, and it's paying off, so it's good for her.' 'Everyone could see that it was Lucy (Bronze). She was really good at scaring people. She got me, but she also got most people in the team. But it was really nice. 'We work really hard most of the time, and we spend so much time focusing on every detail. We speak a lot about our ambitions, how we want to perform on the pitch, and we are professional, so we do that one hundred per cent. 'But it's also good when you can find a good balance and have good laughs and some fun. At the end of the day, football is a game, and when your team is able to play at their best, it's when players have fun on the pitch.' news.body_zh: 周六，我们的女足超级联赛对阵埃弗顿之前，索尼娅·邦帕斯托在科巴姆接受了媒体采访，以下是蓝军主教练所说的关键谈话要点。本赛季我们在 13 场比赛后保持不败，但 Bompastor 保证，当我们在斯坦福桥进入本赛季第五场 WSL 比赛时，准备工作的水平将一如既往地高。主教练报告说，劳伦·詹姆斯将缺席到国际比赛日之前的这组比赛结束，此前扫描证实她在上周末 6-0 战胜查尔顿的比赛中腿筋受伤。与此同时，莱克西·波特又可以上场了。以下是我们主教练周五赛前新闻发布会上的其余关键谈话要点。 “我的职责是确保当我们状态良好时，我们不会走得太高。有时，当事情没有按照我们想要的方式发展时，我们也不会走得太低。我对此负责。 “当然，现在我们对结果和我们在球场上的大部分表现感到满意，但我们不会改变任何事情。我们继续努力，我们保持同样的心态，我们进行高强度的训练，我们在每场比赛中都做好了充分的准备。 '这就是我们需要做的。这个联赛中的每场比赛都如此重要且如此困难，所以我们需要确保我们尽可能长时间地维持这一点。” “对阵任何球队进球总是很困难。与查尔顿的比赛的不同之处可能在于我们在比赛初期就取得了进球，并且在 19 分钟后我们以 4-0 获胜。当你从一开始就真正高效、冷静时，整个游戏就会改变。 'Going into the game tomorrow, we are expecting it might not be possible for us to achieve.他们是一支非常难击败的球队，如果我们想从比赛中获得结果，我们就必须发挥出最好的水平。我们会尽力击垮他们，在比赛中尽早得分，看看他们的反应。 “他们没有丢很多球，他们是一支积极进取的球队，但方式很好。他们在对阵曼联的比赛中取得了不错的成绩，所以我相信他们也会充满信心。我们非常清楚埃弗顿队的威胁和实力，特别是在防守方面。” “饥饿确实很重要。渴望是球队心态和心态的一部分，这就是优秀球队和伟大球队、能够赢得奖杯的球队之间的区别。 “有时候你并不总是能踢出最好的足球，但你总能找到赢得比赛的方法，这非常重要。 We focus a lot on the quality of the performance we want to put on the pitch, but some days it's not always possible for different reasons.我们需要确保当那些日子到来时，我们有那种渴望和心态来扭转局面，即使这不是我们想要的比赛方式。” “埃莉肯定已经在球场上开始了她的行动，而且她可能感觉更自由地进攻。她在训练中一直非常努力，她会留在最后，围绕禁区射门、传中、传中质量、扫描和第一次触球质量做一些额外的工作。 'She's always keen to work hard, and she always asks for extras. She's been doing that from the beginning of the season, and it's paying off, so it's good for her.' “每个人都可以看出那是露西（铜牌）。她确实很擅长吓唬人。她得到了我，但她也得到了团队中的大多数人。 But it was really nice. “我们大部分时间都非常努力地工作，我们花了很多时间关注每一个细节。 We speak a lot about our ambitions, how we want to perform on the pitch, and we are professional, so we do that one hundred per cent. 'But it's also good when you can find a good balance and have good laughs and some fun. At the end of the day, football is a game, and when your team is able to play at their best, it's when players have fun on the pitch.' news.title: Xabi Alonso: Every player will have their moment
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索：每个球员都会有属于自己的时刻
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso is certain that every member of his Chelsea squad will make an impact on the team over the course of this season, believing it is key to make sure every player understands their next opportunity is never far away. Speaking in his pre-match press conference at Cobham on Friday, ahead of our Premier League trip to Sunderland, Alonso was asked whether it was challenging to manage his squad when every player is eager to play as big a role in the team as possible. The Spaniard’s side has seemed settled at times so far this season, but there are always tweaks to be made depending on our game plan and next opponent. Our manager was also quick to point out that the changing nature of form and fitness means any player’s next chance to stake a claim could be right around the corner at any time. ‘There are moments when a player feels that he's far from the pitch, but actually he's not that far,’ explained Alonso. ‘It's about having the opportunity. Everyone will have their moment. ‘We have seen it and we will see it happening again, because of the situations that we are having dealing with injuries in certain positions, some positions more than others. In the end, in the long run, you will see that everyone will play their role.’ Two examples the Blues manager pointed to are Estevao Willian and Wesley Fofana, who both started last week’s 2-0 win over Manchester United in the absence of Joao Pedro and Maxence Lacroix, who remain unavailable for the trip to the Stadium of Light. In the case of Estevao, Alonso felt it was an important moment for the young winger to come into the team and perform well, twice being unlucky to be denied a goal by narrow VAR calls against the Red Devils. ‘It was very good for him, for the team, that he had such an impact,’ our manager continued. ‘We had taken the decision and he knew that was going to be the game, and it was very important for him, that game, and for the team as well.’ Xabi also highlighted the growing maturity shown by Fofana, which he in part attributes to the 25-year-old becoming a father. Our French defender recovered from some first-half errors against Man Utd to play a key role in the brilliant second-half performance that secured all three points, earning praise for his mentality and resilience. ‘It's about dealing with difficult moments and he did many good things,' Alonso added. 'For sure, the mistakes, he knew and he reacted really well. The second half he was solid, he was reliable, as he was in Liverpool. ‘He's already been in the Premier League for years. He's been at this club for four years. It's part of the job to deal with some things that are not what you want, to deal with mistakes, to deal with difficult situations. ‘I'm seeing now Wes is very focused this year. He's mature - he's had his baby, so it's making him more mature - as well as taking more responsibility on the pitch. Sometimes he’s not direct, but sometimes that helps as well. So we support him and he's important.’

news.title: Bompastor delivers injury update on Lauren James and Lexi Potter
news.title_zh: 邦帕斯特发布了劳伦·詹姆斯和莱克西·波特的伤情最新消息
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has confirmed that Lauren James sustained a hamstring injury against Charlton, but there was more positive news about the fitness of Lexi Potter. The Blues sit top of the table following our 6-0 victory over Charlton last weekend, and are currently ahead of rivals Manchester City in second place on goal difference. The only disappointment for Chelsea fans during that emphatic win was that Lauren James was forced off with an injury after 35 minutes, with Erin Cuthbert drafted in to replace her as a substitute. And after having a full week to assess James' fitness, the head coach was able to give an update on her injury. 'LJ will be missing the games until the end of the block,' explained Bompastor. 'She had a scan, and she has an injury in her hamstring. We won’t see her on the pitch until the end of this block. 'Of course, we know how good Lauren is for us, for the team. My job is to make sure I find solutions when players are not available. The good thing is that I looked at some of the statistics we saw from last week, and we are a team who can score with different players. 'A lot of players were involved in the scoring against Charlton, and every player on the pitch had a shot on goal. Even if it was not always a great one, at least all of the players on the pitch had a shot on goal. That's a good thing. My job is to make sure I now find the solutions without LJ on the pitch.' Midfielder Lexi Potter missed out on the Charlton win with a small knee injury sustained against Roma in our 2-0 Women's Champions League victory, but has been training with the squad this week, as Bompastor explained. She said: 'We have Lexi Potter who is back in the squad and in contention for the game.' See the Blues in action against Everton at Stamford Bridge tomorrow! Tickets are available here...

news.title: Xabi Alonso confirms Chelsea team news for Sunderland
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索确认了切尔西队桑德兰队的消息
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso says a decision on Emi Martinez's availability to face Sunderland will be taken tomorrow (Saturday), with the Blues manager also updating on the fitness of Moises Caicedo, Jorrel Hato, Maxence Lacroix and Joao Pedro. After defeating Manchester United at Stamford Bridge last time out, the Blues are on the road this weekend as we make the long journey to Wearside to face a Sunderland side that have won one of their nine top-flight matches this season. Alonso will oversee our final pre-match training session tomorrow at Cobham, after which he will decide who starts against the Black Cats. One choice he may have to make is who starts in goal. Martinez has been sidelined since our win at Everton, after which he underwent jaw surgery, but has returned to training this week wearing protective headgear. ‘Tomorrow we have our last training session before Sunday and we will decide [if he is fit],' Alonso replied when asked about Martinez in his pre-match press conference. 'But he is training well.’ In Martinez's absence, Mike Penders has started our last three matches. And Alonso accepts he may face a difficult decision about who starts between the posts at the Stadium of Light. ‘All the decisions are tough, in all the positions. It is very good that Emi has made a great effort to be back and is ahead of the plan to be part of the team. So, tomorrow we will check and then on Sunday we will take the final decision.’ Alonso will also wait until after tomorrow's session to make a call on the fitness of Moises Caicedo, who was absent from training earlier in the week at Cobham. The Blues manager said: ‘He had little problems after the last game, so we expect to check tomorrow on different situations and Moi is one of them. It’s a discomfort, more than his calf.’ Three players who will definitely be absent this weekend are Hato, Lacroix and Joao Pedro, and Alonso stated that the trio will be assessed over the international break. ‘He isn’t fit yet,' Alonso said on Hato. 'It will take some more weeks. Not yet to be close, maybe after the international break but it’s going to take longer. 'After these two weeks of the international break, we will see how their recovery is and the progress they make. For sure, ahead of the Leeds game, I will have more of an update. But not today.’
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索表示，明天（周六）将决定埃米·马丁内斯能否对阵桑德兰，蓝军主帅还将更新莫伊塞斯·凯塞多、乔雷尔·哈托、马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦和若昂·佩德罗的健康状况。上次在斯坦福桥击败曼联后，蓝军本周末将踏上客场之旅，我们将长途跋涉前往威尔赛德，迎战桑德兰队，他们已经赢得了本赛季九场顶级联赛中的一场比赛。阿隆索明天将在科巴姆监督我们最后的赛前训练，之后他将决定谁在对阵黑猫队的比赛中首发。他可能必须做出的一个选择是由谁首发进球。自从我们战胜埃弗顿以来，马丁内斯就一直缺席比赛，之后他接受了下颌手术，但本周他戴着防护帽重返训练。 “明天我们将在周日之前进行最后一次训练，我们将决定（他是否健康），”阿隆索在赛前新闻发布会上被问及马丁内斯时回答道。 “但他训练得很好。”在马丁内斯缺席的情况下，迈克·潘德斯首发了我们的最后三场比赛。阿隆索承认他可能会面临一个艰难的决定，决定谁在光明球场首发。 “无论在哪个位置，所有的决定都是艰难的。很高兴 Emi 为回归做出了很大的努力，并且提前加入了团队。因此，明天我们将进行检查，然后周日我们将做出最终决定。阿隆索还将等到明天的训练结束后，对莫伊塞斯·凯塞多的健康状况进行评估，他本周早些时候缺席了科巴姆的训练。蓝军主帅表示：“上一场比赛后他几乎没有什么问题，所以我们希望明天检查不同的情况，莫伊就是其中之一。”哈托、拉克鲁瓦和若昂·佩德罗这三名肯定缺席本周末的球员，阿隆索表示，这三人将在国际比赛日期间接受评估。 “他还没有恢复健康，”阿隆索在谈到哈托时说道。 '这还需要几周的时间。尚未接近，也许在国际比赛日之后，但需要更长的时间。 “在这两周的国际比赛日之后，我们将看到他们的恢复情况以及取得的进展。当然，在与利兹联的比赛之前，我会有更多的更新。但今天不行。”

news.title: PGA Division 1 report: Chelsea Women Under-18s 4-0 Sunderland
news.title_zh: PGA Division 1 报告：切尔西 18 岁以下女子队 4-0 桑德兰
news.body_en: Chelsea Women’s Under-18s, who play in the PGA Under-21 Women’s League, made it two wins from two in Division 1 with a 4-0 victory over Sunderland at Cobham. The Blues led inside three minutes through a Sunderland own goal, and Carla Gardiner doubled the advantage three minutes later. Chelsea N’Drin added a third before half-time, and Stevie Sinclair completed the scoring on 71 minutes. Leanne Champ’s side controlled possession and combined well to break down Sunderland and create good goalscoring chances. Positive attacking play was matched by solid defensive work, and the Blues kept a clean sheet. Chelsea led after three minutes. Gabi Storey found captain Belle Sullivan from a free-kick, and she played Rebekah Pierce in behind the Sunderland full-back. Pierce won back possession in the box and drove a cross towards goal, which deflected off a defender and spun under the goalkeeper. The lead was doubled three minutes later. Gardiner combined with Sinclair and Jahmya Putman across the top of the box before beating two defenders and firing a left-footed shot into the bottom corner. The third goal came on 39 minutes. Tess Finn and Sophie Leach worked the ball through midfield to Gardiner, who released Putman down the right. Putman’s ball across found Gardiner, whose first-time shot hit the post, and N’Drin reacted quickly to fire in the rebound. Champ made three changes at half-time, with Ella Booth, Keira Johnson and Aysia Matabaro replacing Zoe Ciccardini, Sullivan and Putman. Annie Boichat and Maria Mayers came on for Finn and N’Drin on the hour. The fourth goal came on 71 minutes. Youngsters Booth and Mayers combined with Leach, who played back to centre-back Boichat. Her long pass over the Sunderland left-back found Matabaro advancing down the right. Matabaro went one-on-one with the full-back and drove inside before slipping the ball through for Johnson, who had made a run behind the defence. Johnson found Sinclair in the six-yard box, and she finished first-time back across goal. Chelsea are unbeaten after our opening two Division 1 fixtures, scoring nine goals and conceding only one. The Blues return to PGA Cup action on Wednesday 11 November, when we host Ipswich Town in the first round at Cobham. Chelsea reached this stage with a 7-1 win over West Ham United in the preliminary round, and beat Ipswich 8-0 at Kingsmeadow when the sides met in the PGA South League in September. news.body_zh: 参加 PGA 21 岁以下女子联赛的切尔西 18 岁以下女子队在科巴姆以 4-0 战胜桑德兰，取得了一级联赛两胜两胜的成绩。蓝军在三分钟内凭借桑德兰的乌龙球领先，三分钟后卡拉·加德纳将优势扩大一倍。切尔西恩德林在半场结束前再进一球，史蒂夫·辛克莱尔在第 71 分钟完成进球。莉安·钱普的球队控制住了控球权，并通过良好的配合打破了桑德兰并创造了良好的进球机会。积极的进攻配合扎实的防守，蓝军保持不失球。三分钟后切尔西领先。加比·斯托里（Gabi Storey）通过任意球找到了队长贝尔·沙利文（Belle Sullivan），她在桑德兰后卫身后扮演了丽贝卡·皮尔斯（Rebekah Pierce）。皮尔斯在禁区内夺回控球权，并向球门传中，球从防守队员身上偏转并在守门员身下旋转。三分钟后，领先优势扩大一倍。加德纳与辛克莱尔和贾米亚·普特曼一起穿过禁区顶部，然后击败了两名防守队员，并将左脚射入底角。第三个进球出现在第39分钟。泰丝·芬恩和索菲·利奇将球从中场传给加德纳，加德纳在右路释放了普特曼。普特曼的球传给了加德纳，加德纳的第一次射门击中了门柱，恩德林迅速反应，将篮板球射中。半场结束时，钱普做出了三项换人，埃拉·布斯、凯拉·约翰逊和艾西亚·马塔巴罗取代了佐伊·西卡迪尼、沙利文和普特曼。安妮·博伊查特和玛丽亚·梅耶斯在整点替补芬恩和恩德林。第四个进球出现在第71分钟。年轻球员布斯和梅耶斯与利奇联手，利奇则回传中卫博伊查特。她长传越过桑德兰左后卫，发现马塔巴罗从右路推进。马塔巴罗与边后卫进行了一对一的进攻，然后带球内切，然后将球传给了跑到防线后面的约翰逊。约翰逊在六码禁区内找到了辛克莱，她第一次完成了射门。切尔西在我们的前两场一级联赛比赛中保持不败，打进 9 球，只丢 1 球。蓝军将于 11 月 11 日星期三重返 PGA 杯比赛，届时我们将在科巴姆主场迎战伊普斯维奇镇。切尔西在预赛中以 7-1 战胜西汉姆联队进入这一阶段，并在 9 月份双方在 PGA 南部联赛中在 Kingsmeadow 交锋时以 8-0 击败伊普斯维奇。切尔西：维多利亚·鲁兹、索菲·利奇、加比·斯托里、佐伊·西卡迪尼（埃拉·布斯 h-t）、贝尔·沙利文（c）（凯拉·约翰逊 HT）、泰丝·芬恩（安妮·博伊查特 60）、史蒂夫·辛克莱、切尔西·恩德林（玛丽亚·梅耶斯 60）、丽贝卡·皮尔斯、卡拉·加德纳、贾米亚·普特曼（艾西亚·马塔巴罗） h-t) 得分手：OG 3、Gardiner 6、N’Drin 39、Sinclair 71 经理：Leanne Champ

news.title: Bompastor and Blues quartet nominated for WSL awards
news.title_zh: Bompastor 和 Blues 四重奏获得 WSL 奖项提名
news.body_en: Two Blues have been nominated for the Women's Super League Player of the Month, Sonia Bompastor is up for the WSL Manager of the Month award, and fans can also vote for Keira Walsh and Maika Hamano to win the WSL Goal of the Month award. The head coach masterminded victories in all three of our league matches in October, first beating West Ham United 3-0 away from home, before returning to Stamford Bridge after the international break to deliver a stunning 6-2 victory over Tottenham Hotspur. Our final match of the month saw us come from behind to seal a 3-1 win against Crystal Palace at the 360 Engage Stadium in Sutton. Ellie Carpenter played every minute of those three matches, getting the crowd off their seats at the Bridge with an emphatic brace against Spurs. The wing-back put in standout performances across the month, working diligently in defence while also getting forward at every opportunity to contribute to the attack. Meanwhile, Chelsea striker Melvine Malard also had a superb month, netting three times. Her stunning goal from range against West Ham contributed to our 3-0 win, while her second-half brace against Palace helped turn the game around after the home side had taken the lead. Both Malard and Carpenter are up for Player of the Month, while Bompastor is in the running for the manager prize, which she has won on four occasions during her time with the Blues. Two outstanding goals from those three matches in October have been nominated for the WSL Goal of the Month award. The first comes from our win against the Hammers, where after receiving a sideways pass from Wieke Kaptein on the edge of the area, Walsh used her tried-and-tested technique from range to lash the ball into the bottom corner to the delight of the travelling fans. You can also vote for Hamano's swerving effort from 30 yards out when she netted against Spurs. The Japan international spent the second half of last season on loan with Martin Ho's side, but there was no room for sentiment when she got the Blues supporters out of their seats at Stamford Bridge with her superb strike. Voting for all three awards is now open and will close at 11am on Monday 9 November. The winners will be announced on Thursday 12 November. You can cast your vote for either Ellie or Melvine for Player of the Month by clicking here. Vote for Bompastor as Manager of the Month here, and either Keira or Maika for Goal of the Month here.

news.title_zh: 切尔西前锋被英格兰国家队征召
news.body_en: Morgan Rogers has been named in the final England squad of 2026. The Chelsea attacker has been selected by Tuchel for the November international break, which follows our game against Sunderland on Sunday, following a superb start to the campaign for club and country. Rogers was a scorer in the last window, in the Three Lions’ big win in Croatia, and has since netted three times for the Blues, including in the recent victory over Manchester United. England have a pair of UEFA Nations League Group C fixtures that will determine whether they progress to next year’s knockout phase. The Three Lions currently sit second in the table with nine points from four matches. Tuchel’s side host Croatia at Wembley on Thursday 12 November, before travelling to Madrid to face top-of-the-table Spain on Sunday 15 November. That game is at the Metropolitano Stadium, the home of Atletico Madrid. At Under-21 level, meanwhile, Josh Acheampong has been selected in Lee Carsley's squad for a pair of friendlies against Portugal and France at Bristol City's Ashton Gate. England are preparing to defend their European Championship crown at next summer's tournament in Albania and Serbia. Tayo Subuloye, Jesse Derry and Shimmy Mheuka have all been named in the England Under-20 squad for their games against Czechia and Portugal, while the Blues quartet of Freddy Bernal, Landon Emenalo, Reggie Walsh and Chizaram Ezenwata have been called up by England Under-19s ahead of three European Championship qualifiers at that level. news.body_en: Chelsea have teamed up with Fantasy Football Scout to help bring you hints, tips and advice during the 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) season. Scout will be using their expertise to provide advice and gameweek tips which should prove useful in ensuring you win your mini-leagues. Here, we look at which Blues players are the best value-for-money picks, why Morgan Rogers (£8.1m) is Chelsea’s most popular player this week and who to captain in Gameweek 10. The deadline is at 6.30pm GMT on Friday ahead of Coventry City’s trip to Everton. Rogers is the most popular Chelsea player ahead of Gameweek 10 with over 200,000 transfers in. The Englishman netted his fifth goal of the season and claimed a share of the bonus against Man United, taking his total goal contributions in all competitions for Chelsea to ten (six goals and four assists). The attacker's ownership has reached 52 per cent, making Rogers the most-selected midfielder in Fantasy, and he has risen in price to £8.1m. In the last six Gameweeks, no Chelsea player has scored more points (31), while Rogers ranks joint-first for big chances (3), first for expected goals and second for expected goal involvement among Blues players. Also proving popular is Cole Palmer (£9.8m), who scored his first goal since Gameweek 2 from the penalty spot against Man United last time out. The Blues number 10 registered four shots on goal and created three chances for his team-mates. Palmer was also just one defensive contribution short of the required threshold for additional points. Since Gameweek 4, the England international has created five big chances, the second-most of any player. Sunderland’s underlying defensive data suggests Palmer will get plenty of opportunities on Sunday to build on his eight-point return from GW9. In the last six Gameweeks, the Black Cats have conceded a league-high 14 goals and rank second-worst for expected goals conceded. Josh Acheampong (£4.5m) continues to establish himself as a reliable, budget defender. The England Under-21 international started for the fourth consecutive Gameweek and picked up a nine-point return thanks to three bonus points, taking his points tally to 17 in three Gameweeks. Furthermore, Acheampong has produced defensive contribution points twice this season in six starts, and averages over seven DefCon per/90. Offensively, Estevao (£6.3m) caught the eye of many Fantasy managers against Man United, with the Brazilian unfortunate not to return. As well as having a well-taken goal narrowly ruled out for offside, Estevao racked up a match-high six shots, 12 penalty box touches and three chances created. The teenager was the cheapest Chelsea attacker to start in GW9. If he can retain his place in the team going forward, Estevao could be a superb differential in FPL. Erling Haaland (£15.8m) is once again a safe captaincy choice for Man City’s away trip to Nottingham Forest. The Norwegian has scored nine goals in the last eight Gameweeks, racking up 66 Fantasy points in that time with two double-digit hauls and 14 bonus points. No player has had more shots on target or xGI than the league’s top-scorer, while Forest have kept just one clean sheet and are winless since Gameweek four. Elsewhere, Alexander Isak (£9.2m) is an intriguing differential option against Crystal Palace. The Eagles have conceded a league-high 31 big chances in nine matches. The Liverpool forward has been bought by over 200,000 managers ahead of the deadline and has scored six goals, only Haaland has more. Isak ranks third among all forwards for xG with 4.35 and shots on target with nine.

news.title: Remembrance at CFCW match
news.title_zh: CFCW比赛纪念
news.body_en: With tomorrow's Women’s Super League fixture at Stamford Bridge taking place the day before Remembrance Sunday, Chelsea FC Women will, at the match, be honouring those lost in conflict. For the commemorations leading up to kick-off against Everton Women, Chelsea Pensioners will flank the players as they walk out of the tunnel, and the Pensioners will join serving personnel from the armed forces in presenting wreaths for laying on the pitch. The Last Post will be sounded by AS1 Scott Kempster - Band of the Royal Air Force Regiment - ahead of a moment’s silence. Supporters are requested to please ensure you are in your seat at least 15 minutes before kick-off to join in the ceremony. The match begins at 12.45pm. With support from Official Online Match Shirt Auction Partner, MatchWornShirt, the shirts with embroidered poppies from the game, worn and signed by the relevant player, will be auctioned. All net proceeds are donated to the Royal British Legion’s Poppy Appeal. Also supporting the appeal, Chelsea badges and scarves bearing the poppy will be on sale in Megastore at Stamford Bridge. The Chelsea men’s team dedicated home match for Remembrance was last weekend against Manchester United.

The Chelsea men’s team dedicated home match for Remembrance was last weekend against Manchester United.

news.body_en: Chelsea head to Sunderland on Sunday looking to make it back-to-back victories in the Premier League. Here are all the key facts and figures you need ahead of kick-off. Chelsea’s win against Manchester United on matchweek nine moved us into the top four in the Premier League table. Sunday’s opponents Sunderland are bottom, with one win and two draws so far. This fixture has seen 124 goals scored in 34 Premier League matches, averaging 3.65 goals per game. Our last victory at the Stadium of Light came in December 2016, when a goal from Cesc Fabregas just before half-time earned us a 1-0 win. We have played there only once since. In the home match in 2016/17, Chelsea won 5-1. Last season’s defeat on the last day of the season was only our second in 14 Premier League visits to the Stadium of Light, where we have recorded 10 wins and two draws. Chelsea are aiming to prevent the Black Cats recording a third consecutive league victory against us for the first time since a run of three between 1999 and 2001. news.title: Heritage event hosted at Stamford Bridge for Remembrance
news.title_zh: 在斯坦福桥举办的遗产纪念活动
news.body_en: Ahead of Saturday's match against Manchester United where those lost in conflict were honoured for Remembrance Day, commemorations were also held in collaboration with the Chelsea Heritage Partnership as part of the Those Were The Days series. The venue was the Tea Bar at Stamford Bridge and those present were joined by members of our Armed Forces Supporters Group and club legends. The event focused on a football scandal dating back over a hundred years to the First World War, when Chelsea was the ultimate victim of a match-fixing scandal between two of our great rivals, Liverpool and Manchester United. There was also an on-screen presentation from club historian Rick Glanvill, reflecting on those players and staff who made the ultimate sacrifice in the war, alongside video of iconic past matches against the Red Devils and memorabilia from those great games for fans to enjoy. Prized historical artefacts and photos were on display around the venue. The club would like to thank the Chelsea Heritage Partnership for its work in putting together another fantastic event.
news.body_zh: 在周六对阵曼联的比赛之前，在冲突中丧生的人们被纪念为阵亡将士纪念日，作为“那些日子”系列的一部分，我们还与切尔西遗产合作伙伴合作举办了纪念活动。地点是斯坦福桥的茶吧，出席的还有我们的武装部队支持者团体的成员和俱乐部传奇人物。该活动聚焦于一场可以追溯到一百多年前的第一次世界大战的足球丑闻，当时切尔西是我们两个伟大对手利物浦和曼联之间假球丑闻的最终受害者。俱乐部历史学家里克·格兰维尔也在屏幕上进行了介绍，回顾了那些在战争中做出最终牺牲的球员和工作人员，同时还播放了过去对阵红魔的标志性比赛的视频以及这些伟大比赛的纪念品，供球迷欣赏。会场周围陈列着珍贵的历史文物和照片。俱乐部要感谢切尔西传统合作伙伴组织为举办另一场精彩的活动所做的工作。

news.title: Carlo Cudicini interview: Sunderland saves, penalty record and personal honour
news.title_zh: 卡洛·库迪奇尼专访：桑德兰扑救、点球记录和个人荣誉
news.body_en: With the 25th anniversary of a legendary performance from Carlo Cudicini away to Sunderland approaching, we caught up with the former Chelsea goalkeeper ahead of this weekend's visit to Wearside... Earlier this year, Carlo Cudicini was asked a simple question that was far from easy to answer. ‘What was your best performance in a Chelsea shirt?’ The passage of time dictates that memories fade, but those that linger burn the brightest. You could almost see Cudicini whirring through his 200-plus games for the Blues, from his debut in August 1999 to his final appearance for us nearly ten years later. Eventually, he settled on a ‘game at Sunderland, a goalless draw’. For a man who represented Chelsea with such distinction – in high-profile Premier League games, FA Cup finals, Champions League classics – a 0-0 at the Stadium of Light on a wintry December afternoon might be considered an inauspicious response. Watch back the highlights, though, and you get the sense of a goalkeeper at the very top of his game. Kevin Phillips, one of the Premier League’s top strikers at the turn of the century, is denied on three occasions, including from the penalty spot followed by an improbable save with the Italian’s feet from a few yards out. ‘It was probably related more to feeling than anything else,’ Cudicini, now Chelsea’s head of talent and pathways, tells us at Cobham this week when we enquire about that Sunderland performance. ‘Most of the time, a player or a keeper’s performance is just judged on whether he scores or saves, but I think it’s more related to what the feeling was during the game. And that day, there was just no way they were scoring a goal. ‘That was the feeling I probably developed throughout the game, after making the first save. It’s all about momentum. And as well I loved to play away, because you get the feeling the opponents keep coming, you keep saving, and the supporters get frustrated because it’s like going up against a wall.’ Cudicini can recall only a handful of occasions throughout his career when he felt truly unbeatable. The Sunderland game 25 years ago was one of them, and an important factor behind Cudicini’s inner belief that he would not concede was the way he got in Phillips’ head. ‘A big part of being a goalkeeper is the psychological battle with the striker, without a doubt,’ Cudicini explains. ‘If on one side you feel unbeatable, on the other you frustrate the striker who can only say: “What do I have to do?” ‘That gets in their mind. They can overthink it and there’s a component in there saying: “Maybe I’m trying too hard to score.”’ Cudicini remembers a sense of personal pride and satisfaction with his performance at the Stadium of Light, but in the context of the season, it was two points dropped. Claudio Ranieri’s Blues had aspirations of finishing in the top four. Unfortunately, inconsistency continued to plague us. A week prior to the Sunderland game, we took the champions Manchester United apart at Old Trafford, a clinic of counter-attacking football securing a famous 3-0 success. But that was followed by a 1-0 loss at home to lowly Charlton, and then the goalless draw on Wearside. The next weekend, we thrashed top-of-the-table Liverpool 4-0. Cudicini saved yet another penalty in that game, this time from Gary McAllister. His stop from Darren Bent’s spot-kick the following April means he is a member of an exclusive club to have saved a record three penalties in a single Premier League season. ‘Obviously you need a bit of luck, but there were probably two main points to my penalty record,’ reflects Cudicini, who would deny Ruud van Nistelrooy and Thierry Henry from 12 yards later in his Chelsea career. ‘One was my characteristics as a goalkeeper. Not being the tallest meant I was very elastic, very springy, very reactive, and with penalties you need that, because a centimetre can be the difference. ‘At the same time, I did a lot of research at a time when we didn’t have data, like a goalkeeper coach coming in the day before the match saying, “Those are where he took the last ten penalties”. I played at the wrong time for that! ‘I started the work during pre-season, watching every friendly where a lot of times it finished with penalties. I would take notes. Then, during the season, I would watch every episode of Match of the Day, looking at the penalties, what minute they were in, the scoreline, where it was going. ‘So I was going into games having my philosophy around that, based on research I had done, and that year it worked brilliantly.’ The 2001/02 campaign culminated with Cudicini becoming just the fourth goalkeeper to win the Chelsea Player of the Season award. That was no mean feat, partly because Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink and Eidur Gudjohnsen formed a deadly strike partnership that year, scoring a remarkable 52 goals between them. Not only that, but Cudicini didn’t actually establish himself in the Chelsea starting XI until two weeks before the draw at Sunderland. A pre-season injury handed Ed de Goey a place back between the posts on the opening day, and then when the Dutchman’s form dipped, Ranieri turned to Mark Bosnich. It wasn’t until he tore a thigh muscle late on in a goalless draw at Goodison Park that Cudicini was handed his chance. It was one he grabbed with both hands, registering six clean sheets in his first seven games back, not least because of that pair of penalty saves in consecutive weeks. ‘I was disappointed because I thought I’d done enough the season before to start again when I was fit. Mark had a couple of good games, so I understood that, but I was disappointed. ‘I was training very well and thinking that surely it had to change. As a goalkeeper, you either play or you don’t. You can’t come on for 20 minutes. But when Mark got injured, I stepped in. That’s how it works for goalkeepers. ‘I remember I had such huge energy after the Everton game. I came on for Mark and made a good save right at the end to keep it 0-0. All that frustration at not playing built up, and then that good energy and good feeling from the game brought me momentum.’ Cudicini’s presence between the posts proved pivotal in the Blues securing a sixth-placed finish and with it, European football for the following campaign. We did well in the domestic cups, too, reaching the semi-finals of the League Cup and then the final of the FA Cup. Alas, our north London rivals put paid to our hopes of silverware, but our No.23 did still end the season with a trophy in his hands. ‘The Player of the Year didn’t exist at that time in Italy,’ Cudicini says. ‘I remember my first year when I joined Chelsea, and there was the Player of the Year, and I was asking Roberto [Di Matteo], Gianfranco [Zola], obviously Italian guys: "What is this all about?” ‘They explained to me, so I understood its importance. So when I was awarded one, it was a great honour. I was really proud of the relationship that I managed to build with the fans. ‘Personally, that season was probably the most important in my career at Chelsea,' adds Cudicini. 'Coming from Castel di Sangro for £150,000, being alone, not playing at the start, it was all the build-up to that season. ‘A lot of it was down to my relationship with the fans, I think. Coming from Italy, you're passionate, so you get agitated, you get upset, you celebrate with the fans. That was the bond we had.’ As much as memories fade, the image of Cudicini clenching his fists and roaring with joy after saving a penalty will live in Chelsea supporters’ minds for a long while yet.
news.body_zh: 随着卡洛·库迪奇尼客场对阵桑德兰的传奇表演 25 周年纪念日的临近，我们在本周末造访威尔赛德之前采访了这位前切尔西门将……今年早些时候，卡洛·库迪奇尼被问到了一个简单的问题，但这个问题很难回答。 “你身披切尔西球衣的最佳表现是什么？”随着时间的流逝，记忆会逐渐淡去，但那些挥之不去的记忆却最为明亮。从 1999 年 8 月的首秀到近十年后他为我们出场的最后一场比赛，你几乎可以看到库迪奇尼为蓝军效力的 200 多场比赛。最终，他选择了“对阵桑德兰的比赛，一场互交白卷”。对于一个代表切尔西队在备受瞩目的英超比赛、足总杯决赛、欧冠经典赛中表现出色的人来说，在12月寒冷的下午在光明球场以0-0的比分可能会被认为是一个不吉利的回应。不过，回顾一下精彩片段，你就会感受到一名守门员在比赛中处于巅峰状态的感觉。凯文·菲利普斯是世纪之交英超联赛的顶级前锋之一，他曾三次被挡出球门，其中包括在点球点上被意大利人在几码外用脚不可思议地扑出。 “这可能更多地与感觉有关，而不是其他任何事情，”库迪奇尼，现任切尔西人才和途径主管，本周在科巴姆询问桑德兰的表现时告诉我们。 “大多数时候，一个球员或守门员的表现只是根据他是否进球或扑救来判断，但我认为这更与比赛时的感觉有关。那天，他们根本不可能进球。 “这就是我在完成第一次扑救后在整场比赛中产生的感觉。这一切都与动力有关。我也喜欢在客场比赛，因为你会感觉到对手不断涌来，你不断救球，而支持者会感到沮丧，因为这就像撞墙一样。”库迪奇尼记得在他的职业生涯中，只有少数几次他感到真正不可战胜。 25年前对阵桑德兰的比赛就是其中之一，而库迪奇尼内心坚信自己不会失球的一个重要因素就是他在菲利普斯脑海中的表现方式。 “毫无疑问，作为守门员的一个重要部分是与前锋的心理斗争，”库迪奇尼解释道。 “如果一方面你感觉自己不可战胜，另一方面你又让前锋感到沮丧，他只能说：“我必须做什么？” '这进入了他们的脑海。他们可能会想太多，其中有一个成分在说：“也许我太努力得分了。”库迪奇尼记得他在光明球场的表现有一种个人自豪感和满足感，但在本赛季的背景下，丢了两分。克劳迪奥·拉涅利的蓝军渴望进入前四。不幸的是，不一致继续困扰着我们。对阵桑德兰的比赛前一周，我们在老特拉福德球场击败了冠军曼联，这是一场反击足球的诊所，最终以 3-0 取得了著名的胜利。但随后他们在主场0-1输给了弱旅查尔顿，然后又0比0战平威尔赛德。接下来的周末，我们以 4-0 击败了积分榜榜首的利物浦。库迪奇尼在那场比赛中再次扑出了加里·麦卡利斯特的点球。第二年四月，他在达伦·本特的点球中被扑出，这意味着他是一个在英超单赛季扑出了创纪录的三个点球的俱乐部的成员。 “显然你需要一点运气，但我的点球记录可能有两个要点，”库迪奇尼回忆道，在他的切尔西生涯后期，他在 12 码处挡出了范尼斯特鲁伊和蒂埃里·亨利。 “其中之一是我作为守门员的特点。不是最高的意味着我非常有弹性，非常有弹性，非常反应性，并且在处罚中你需要这一点，因为一厘米可能会有所不同。 “与此同时，在我们没有数据的情况下，我做了很多研究，就像比赛前一天守门员教练说的那样，‘这些是他最后十个点球的地方’。我玩错时间了！ “我在季前赛期间就开始了这项工作，观看了每一场友谊赛，很多时候都是以点球结束。 I would take notes.然后，在整个赛季中，我会观看每日比赛的每一集，查看点球大战、比赛进行到哪一分钟、比分、以及进展情况。 ‘So I was going into games having my philosophy around that, based on research I had done, and that year it worked brilliantly.’ The 2001/02 campaign culminated with Cudicini becoming just the fourth goalkeeper to win the Chelsea Player of the Season award. That was no mean feat, partly because Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink and Eidur Gudjohnsen formed a deadly strike partnership that year, scoring a remarkable 52 goals between them.不仅如此，库迪奇尼直到对阵桑德兰的抽签前两周才真正跻身切尔西首发阵容。 A pre-season injury handed Ed de Goey a place back between the posts on the opening day, and then when the Dutchman’s form dipped, Ranieri turned to Mark Bosnich.直到在古迪逊公园球场的一场0-0平局中，他大腿肌肉撕裂，库迪奇尼才得到了机会。 It was one he grabbed with both hands, registering six clean sheets in his first seven games back, not least because of that pair of penalty saves in consecutive weeks. “我很失望，因为我以为自己在上个赛季已经做得足够了，可以在身体健康时重新开始。马克打了几场精彩的比赛，所以我理解这一点，但我很失望。 “我训练得很好，我想这肯定需要改变。作为守门员，你要么上场，要么不上场。 20分钟内你不能上场。但当马克受伤时，我介入了。这就是守门员的工作方式。 “我记得在与埃弗顿的比赛后我充满了能量。我替补了马克，并在比赛最后时刻做出了精彩扑救，将比分改写为0-0。 All that frustration at not playing built up, and then that good energy and good feeling from the game brought me momentum.’ Cudicini’s presence between the posts proved pivotal in the Blues securing a sixth-placed finish and with it, European football for the following campaign.我们在国内杯赛上也取得了不错的成绩，联赛杯打进了半决赛，足总杯也打进了决赛。唉，我们北伦敦的对手让我们获得奖杯的希望落空了，但我们的 23 号球员仍然手里拿着一座奖杯结束了赛季。 “当时意大利还没有年度最佳球员，”库迪奇尼说。 ‘I remember my first year when I joined Chelsea, and there was the Player of the Year, and I was asking Roberto [Di Matteo], Gianfranco [Zola], obviously Italian guys: "What is this all about?” “他们向我解释，所以我明白了它的重要性。因此，当我获得这一奖项时，我感到非常荣幸。我对我与粉丝建立的关系感到非常自豪。 “就我个人而言，那个赛季可能是我在切尔西的职业生涯中最重要的一个赛季，”库迪奇尼补充道。 “以15万英镑的身价从桑格罗堡来到这里，独自一人，一开始就没有参加比赛，这都是为那个赛季做的准备。 “我认为这很大程度上取决于我与球迷的关系。来自意大利，你充满激情，所以你会变得焦躁、不安，你会和球迷一起庆祝。 That was the bond we had.’ As much as memories fade, the image of Cudicini clenching his fists and roaring with joy after saving a penalty will live in Chelsea supporters’ minds for a long while yet.

news.title: Melvine Malard on why there's even more to come from her at Chelsea
news.title_zh: 梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard) 讲述为何她在切尔西能取得更多成就
news.body_en: Melvine Malard has hit the ground running at Chelsea. Our new number nine has scored eight goals in seven starts and three substitute appearances since signing from Manchester United this summer. Little wonder, then, she is our top scorer so far. Last season, she netted six times in 21 league outings for the Red Devils, but she has now equalled that tally in her first six WSL games with Chelsea. When we sit down with the France international, we mention how her strike rate has so clearly improved. We then ask her what she attributes her good form to, but her answer comes as a surprise. Six goals in six league games, and Malard feels we haven't seen anything yet. ‘I don’t think I’m in my good form yet; that’s the thing,’ she says with a huge smile. ‘Not yet. ‘When you play with a lot of quality individuals, it can help you a lot. Having a positive vibe in your head can also help you a lot. I just need to keep going to reach my top form. ‘What I understand more now with the number nine role is you need to have a lot of patience, and you need to be ready in the box when players give you the ball.’ Malard has settled in so quickly to life at Chelsea. She talks about positivity, and she certainly brings the vibes around the training ground and on the pitch. The time has flown since her arrival in July, and she gives us some insight into the team’s hectic schedule and how she stays focused on the task in front of her. ‘It’s busy, very busy,’ she explains. ‘We play a lot of games with big intensity against a lot of quality players, so it’s busy but very good. ‘When you play well, you feel good, and you win. Also, you score goals. That's my job. I’m very happy to be here and to be doing my job at the moment. I’m taking it game by game. We have a lot of matches, with the Champions League and the national team and everything like that. ‘My job is to help the team when I can: to take responsibility, and take the opportunities I have in front of goal and don’t overthink things. If you make sure you play with passion, you enjoy your football and score the goals. ‘You can see that many people can score in this team, so I don’t worry about it. With good team-mates around you, you know you can have a lot of opportunities, a lot of action in front of goal and okay, if you miss that one, the next player will give you another ball to try again.’ Malard played for Sonia Bompastor from the age of 14. After making the move from her home on the island of La Reunion in the Indian Ocean to play for Lyon, she is now in her second spell under Bompastor and details how the head coach has evolved since then. ‘Sonia is the same,’ she says. ‘The same coach demanding a lot. She’s very exigent with you and your quality. But it’s good to have a coach that pushes you a lot and makes sure you don’t become complacent. ‘She’s maybe a little bit more relaxed here. She shows more happiness. We know in England it’s very free, so she can speak her mind. It’s good to feel free.’ This Saturday sees Chelsea host Everton at Stamford Bridge in the WSL. When we ask her what we can expect, the striker pauses and gives us a thoughtful answer on what a fast start could mean for her team-mates. It’s evident she cares very much about the collective. ‘Everton also have good players, good quality,’ she says when asked about the opposition. ‘They play direct, and when they have the opportunity to shoot, they are not scared to do it, no matter who is in front of them. 'We need to make sure we are always focused on every ball and every player. We want to score quickly. We saw against Charlton that when we score quickly in the first half, we can also allow other players to enjoy the game, like Giulia (Dragoni). 'When she scored her first, she had a lot of emotion because the team did their jobs in the first half and gave her the chance to show her football. If we can do that in every game, it's good for our team, and everyone is happy.' Malard isn’t the kind of player who wants to talk at length about individual accolades. When we ask her about attending last month’s Ballon d’Or ceremony, she once again relates being ranked 28th in the world to how it rewarded the most important people in her life. ‘It was amazing,’ she says. ‘You sacrifice a lot in your life to become a footballer, so it’s special when you are nominated. I went with my wife and my mum. It was a big thank you very much for all the help they have given me in my life. ‘But we need to keep going to be nominated again. Because football is not easy. I went to the ceremony, but now it’s done. We need to move on and keep working hard. ‘I’d like to get higher up the list, but there is a lot of talent so the places are tight. You just need to keep doing your best.’ See Melvine and the Blues in action against Everton at Stamford Bridge on Saturday! Tickets are available here...
news.body_zh: 梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard) 在切尔西已经崭露头角。自从今年夏天从曼联加盟以来，我们的新九号在七场首发和三场替补出场中打进了八个进球。难怪她是我们迄今为止的最佳得分手。上赛季，她在代表红魔出战的 21 场联赛中攻入 6 球，但现在她在代表切尔西的前六场 WSL 比赛中追平了这一进球数。当我们与这位法国国脚坐下来时，我们提到她的进球率如何明显提高。然后我们问她，她将自己的良好状态归因于什么，但她的回答令人惊讶。六场联赛中的六个进球，马拉德觉得我们还没有看到任何东西。 “我认为我的状态还不是很好；就是这样，”她笑着说道。 '还没有。 “当你和很多优秀的人一起踢球时，这会对你有很大帮助。头脑中保持积极的氛围也会对你有很大帮助。我只需要继续达到我的最佳状态。 “我现在对九号角色更了解的是，你需要有很大的耐心，当球员给你球时，你需要在禁区内做好准备。”马拉德很快就适应了切尔西的生活。她谈论积极性，她确实给训练场和球场带来了积极的氛围。自她七月份到来以来，时间过得真快，她向我们介绍了团队繁忙的日程以及她如何专注于眼前的任务。 “很忙，非常忙，”她解释道。 “我们与很多优秀的球员进行了很多高强度的比赛，所以很忙碌，但非常好。 “当你打得好的时候，你感觉很好，你就会赢。此外，你还能进球。这就是我的工作。我很高兴来到这里并做好我现在的工作。我会逐场比赛。我们有很多比赛，包括冠军联赛和国家队等等。 “我的工作是尽我所能帮助球队：承担责任，抓住进球前的机会，不要想得太多。如果你确保自己充满激情地踢球，你就会享受足球并进球。 ‘你可以看到这支球队里有很多人都能进球，所以我不担心。有了优秀的队友在你身边，你知道你可以有很多机会，在球门前有很多动作，好吧，如果你错过了那个机会，下一个球员会给你另一个球，让你再试一次。”马拉德从 14 岁起就为索尼娅·邦帕斯托效力。在从印度洋留尼汪岛的家搬到里昂效力后，她现在是在邦帕斯托的第二次执教，并详细介绍了主教练自那以后是如何发展的。 “索尼娅也是一样，”她说。 “同一个教练要求很高。她对你和你的品质非常严格。但有一位教练会不断鞭策你并确保你不会自满，这是件好事。 “她在这里可能更放松一点。她表现出更多的幸福。我们知道在英国这是非常自由的，所以她可以说出自己的想法。自由的感觉真好。” 本周六，WSL 切尔西将在斯坦福桥迎战埃弗顿。当我们问她我们可以期待什么时，这位前锋停了下来，给了我们一个深思熟虑的答案，说明快速启动对她的队友意味着什么。看得出来她非常关心集体。 “埃弗顿也有优秀的球员，素质很高，”当被问及对手时她说道。 “他们打球直接，当他们有机会射门时，他们不会害怕这样做，无论他们面前的是谁。 “我们需要确保我们始终专注于每个球和每个球员。我们想要快速得分。我们在对阵查尔顿的比赛中看到，当我们在上半场快速得分时，我们也可以让其他球员享受比赛，比如朱利亚（德拉戈尼）。 “当她打进第一个进球时，她非常激动，因为球队在上半场完成了自己的工作，给了她展示足球的机会。如果我们能在每场比赛中做到这一点，这对我们的球队有好处，每个人都会很高兴。”马拉德并不是那种愿意详细谈论个人荣誉的球员。当我们问她参加上个月的金球奖颁奖典礼时，她再次谈到了世界排名第 28 位是如何奖励她生命中最重要的人的。 “太棒了，”她说。 “为了成为一名足球运动员，你在生活中牺牲了很多，所以当你被提名时，这是很特别的。我和我的妻子和妈妈一起去的。非常感谢他们在我的生活中给予我的所有帮助。 ‘But we need to keep going to be nominated again.因为足球并不容易。我参加了仪式，但现在已经结束了。我们需要继续前进并继续努力。 ‘I’d like to get higher up the list, but there is a lot of talent so the places are tight. You just need to keep doing your best.’ See Melvine and the Blues in action against Everton at Stamford Bridge on Saturday!门票可以在这里购买...

news.title: October Chelsea Goal of the Month winner revealed!
news.title_zh: 切尔西十月最佳进球得主揭晓！
news.body_en: For the second month in a row, Morgan Rogers has received the Chelsea Goal of the Month award. Since joining the Blues from Aston Villa in the summer, Rogers has now won two of the three Goal of the Month awards available, including the last two in a row. That has come during a brilliant start to his Chelsea career, which has seen him become the first Blues player – and only the second across the entire Premier League – to reach ten goal involvements (six goals, four assists) in all competitions this season. His two award-winning goals showed very different qualities, too. In September, it was for his instinctive volley into the bottom corner from the edge of the box away at Arsenal. This time around, he finished top of the October poll thanks to his opener against Manchester United at Stamford Bridge, taking the ball from Romeo Lavia near the centre-circle and driving forward through the heart of the defence and into the box, before lifting a composed finish over the keeper. It was a tight race for the October Goal of the Month award, though. Jordan Henderson’s first Chelsea goal, swept in against Bournemouth, came second with 34 per cent of the votes, while the midfielder’s free-kick scored later in the same game was a distant third. However, it is Rogers who triumphs for the second month in a row by receiving 39 per cent of supporters’ votes on the Chelsea Official App.
news.body_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯连续第二个月荣获切尔西月度最佳进球奖。自从今年夏天从阿斯顿维拉加盟蓝军以来，罗杰斯现在已经赢得了三个月度最佳进球奖中的两个，包括连续两个奖项。这是他在切尔西职业生涯的辉煌开局之际实现的，这让他成为本赛季第一个在所有比赛中打入 10 粒进球（6 个进球，4 次助攻）的蓝军球员，也是整个英超联赛中第二个。他的两个获奖进球也表现出了截然不同的品质。 9月，在客场对阵阿森纳的比赛中，他在禁区边缘本能的抽射打入底角。这一次，他凭借在斯坦福桥对阵曼联的首开纪录，在十月份的评选中名列前茅，他从中圈附近的罗密欧·拉维亚手中接过球，向前突破防守中心，进入禁区，然后冷静地越过门将射门。不过，十月最佳进球奖的争夺十分激烈。乔丹·亨德森在对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中攻入切尔西的第一个进球，以 34% 的得票率位居第二，而这位中场球员后来在同一场比赛中打进的任意球则远远落后于第三。然而，罗杰斯连续第二个月获胜，在切尔西官方应用程序上获得了 39% 的支持者投票。

news.title: Help Mike Penders win Premier League Save of the Month
news.title_zh: 帮助迈克·彭德斯赢得英超本月拯救奖
news.body_en: Mike Penders has received a nomination for the October Premier League Save of the Month award. Our Belgian goalkeeper only made his Premier League debut two weeks ago, when he came off the bench to replace the injured Emiliano Martinez in the 2-0 win away at Everton. Vote for Mike Penders to win the October Premier League Save of the Month award He continued between the posts for our remaining two league fixtures in October, keeping his first solo clean sheet in the most recent of those, when we beat Manchester United 2-0 at Stamford Bridge. It was in that game that Penders produced the stunning save which has been nominated for the monthly award. He showed quick reflexes and excellent agility to divert Bryan Mbeumo’s powerful drive onto the crossbar with his fingertips late on, keeping his clean sheet intact. Alongside Penders, the other five goalkeepers on the award shortlist are Zion Suzuki (Aston Villa), Bart Verbruggen (Brighton & Hove Albion), Christian Walton (Ipswich Town), Walter Benitez and Dean Henderson (both Crystal Palace). The winner will be decided by a public poll and you can help Penders to claim the October Premier League Save of the Month award by casting your vote here before the deadline of midday on Monday 9 November. The winning goalkeeper will be revealed at 2pm on Friday 13 November.
news.body_zh: 迈克·潘德斯获得十月英超联赛月度拯救奖提名。我们的比利时门将两周前才完成英超首秀，当时他在客场2-0战胜埃弗顿的比赛中替补受伤的埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯出场。投票选举迈克·彭德斯获得十月英超联赛月度最佳扑救奖。十月份我们剩下的两场联赛中，他继续担任门将，在最近的一场比赛中，我们在斯坦福桥以 2-0 击败曼联，保持了他的第一次个人零失球。正是在那场比赛中，彭德斯做出了令人惊叹的扑救，并获得了月度奖提名。他表现出快速的反应和出色的敏捷性，最后用指尖将布莱恩·姆博莫的强力射门转移到横梁上，保持了不失球。除彭德斯外，入围名单中的其他五名门将分别是锡安·铃木（阿斯顿维拉）、巴特·维尔布鲁根（布莱顿）、克里斯蒂安·沃尔顿（伊普斯维奇）、沃尔特·贝尼特斯和迪恩·亨德森（均为水晶宫）。获胜者将通过公众投票选出，您可以在 11 月 9 日星期一中午截止日期之前在这里投票，帮助彭德斯获得 10 月份英超联赛最佳拯救奖。获胜门将将于 11 月 13 日星期五下午 2 点揭晓。

news.title: Vote Xabi Alonso for Premier League Manager of the Month
news.title_zh: 投票哈维·阿隆索为本月英超最佳教练
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has been included on the shortlist for the Premier League Manager of the Month award for the second time already this season. Our Spanish manager previously made the shortlist in August, following his first few weeks in the Chelsea dugout, and now receives a nomination for October's award. Vote for Xabi Alonso to win Premier League Manager of the Month It follows a strong month for the Blues, during which we won three of our four league games. That started when we returned from the extended international break with a 5-1 thrashing of Bournemouth, before we took that form on the road to secure our first Premier League clean sheet of the campaign in a 2-0 win at Everton. Following a setback against Tottenham Hotspur, Chelsea got straight back to winning ways on the final day of the month, producing an excellent second-half performance to beat Manchester United 2-0 at Stamford Bridge. Alonso is one of six names on the shortlist for the award, facing competition from Mikel Arteta (Arsenal), Roberto De Zerbi (Tottenham), Unai Emery (Aston Villa), Fabian Hurzeler (Brighton & Hove Albion) and Marco Rose (Bournemouth). You can help the Chelsea manager collect the award by casting your vote for the October Premier League Manager of the Month here before the poll closes at midday on Monday 9 November. The winner will be revealed at midday on Friday 13 November.
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索本赛季第二次入围英超月度最佳教练奖候选名单。我们的西班牙主教练在切尔西教练席的头几周后，曾于八月份入围候选名单，现在获得了十月份奖项的提名。投票支持哈维·阿隆索赢得本月英超最佳主教练 蓝军在一个月内表现强劲，在此期间我们赢得了四场联赛中的三场。这一切始于我们结束国际比赛日后以5-1大胜伯恩茅斯的比赛，随后我们在客场以2-0战胜埃弗顿，确保了本赛季首个英超不失球。切尔西队在对阵托特纳姆热刺队的比赛中遭遇挫折后，在本月的最后一天重新回到胜利轨道，下半场表现出色，在斯坦福桥以 2-0 击败了曼联队。阿隆索是该奖项入围名单中的六名球员之一，面临着米克尔·阿尔特塔（阿森纳）、罗伯托·德泽尔比（托特纳姆热刺）、乌奈·埃梅里（阿斯顿维拉）、法比安·胡尔泽勒（布莱顿）和马可·罗斯（伯恩茅斯）的竞争。您可以在 11 月 9 日星期一中午投票结束之前，在这里投票选出 10 月份英超联赛最佳教练，帮助切尔西主帅领取奖项。获胜者将于 11 月 13 日星期五中午揭晓。

news.title: Chelsea loan report: Essugo, Murray-Campbell and Samuels-Smith impress
news.title_zh: 切尔西租借报告：埃苏戈、穆雷-坎贝尔和萨缪尔斯-史密斯令人印象深刻
news.body_en: Chelsea's players out on loan continued their development across Europe and the English football pyramid during October, with several making important contributions for their temporary clubs. We take a look at how the Blues' loanees performed during the month, with Dario Essugo, Harrison Murray-Campbell and Ishe Samuels-Smith among those catching the eye. Dario Essugo started each of Strasbourg’s three games in October, deployed in the centre of the Ligue 1 side’s midfield. He scored the opening goal, his first for the club, in Strasbourg’s 2-1 defeat to Nice, while also playing the full 90 minutes against European champions Paris Saint-Germain. Genesis Antwi and Filip Jorgensen continue to provide a strong contribution with both also starting all three games. Samuels-Smith continued his impressive development at Notts County, featuring in five matches across League One and the EFL Trophy. He completed the full 90 minutes in four of those appearances, including the victories over Sheffield Wednesday and Nottingham Forest’s Under-21s, and demonstrated his versatility by featuring at centre-back and on the left of midfield. Murray-Campbell (pictured top) remains an important member of RC Kortrijk’s defence in his first loan spell in senior football. The 20-year-old played in the games against Genk and Standard Liege, with Kortrijk earning a hard-fought point away from home in the latter. October saw Derry make his debut appearance in the UEFA Champions League during the Portuguese side's 2-0 win away to Lens. The winger provided an assist for Sporting Lisbon in their 2-1 victory over Maritimo in the quarter-finals of the Portuguese League Cup. Wilson has been an ever-present for Rochdale this season, with the highlight of his October a clean sheet kept in a battling 1-0 success over Swindon Town at the start of the month. Seventeen-year-old Kavuma-McQueen enjoyed another productive month with Portsmouth, featuring in six Championship fixtures during October. The young winger made his presence felt particularly in the 3-2 victory over Sheffield United, claiming an assist as Pompey secured an important three points. Walsh continues to gain valuable senior experience at Wigan Athletic, featuring in all six of the League One side's October fixtures. He provided an assist in their game against Huddersfield and started both the Latics’ victories during the month, against Reading and Barrow. Emenalo made his senior debut in October as Celtic beat Hearts 7-1. He followed that up by featuring in the draw with Dundee United. Mhueka was also involved in all three Scottish Premiership fixtures. Satpayev returned to action during October following an injury that restricted his involvement in September. The 18-year-old made three appearances for Burnley, taking his total to seven since joining the Championship club on loan. It was an excellent month for Sarr and Real Sociedad. The defender started each of their six fixtures, with four of those won, including three in La Liga. Those victories have seen them rise to fifth in the table. They also picked up their maiden Europa League victory of the campaign, thrashing Lillestrom 6-0 away from home. Having returned from suspension, Disasi started Palace’s Premier League games against Newcastle and Tottenham towards the end of the month. He also played the full 90 minutes in the Eagles’ Europa League fixtures away to Lyon and Besiktas. Badiashile started four matches for Napoli in the heart of defence, including a Champions League defeat at Villarreal and a thrilling 3-3 draw with Roma. Unfortunately, an injury sustained in that game has ruled him out of Napoli’s past two fixtures. Sanchez played twice for Como, starting their Champions League defeat to Feyenoord and 3-1 Serie A victory over Torino. Garnacho saw more involvement for Villa in October, coming off the bench in four games including the Champions League successes at home to Fenerbahce and Viking Stavanger. Harrison has firmly established himself in Wimbledon’s midfield, starting six of their seven appearances in a busy October. He accumulated more than 300 minutes of football in the process. Richards, meanwhile, is currently sidelined through injury. Kiano Dyer continues to feature regularly for Chesterfield in League Two. He made five appearances for the Spireites, who are currently positioned in tenth place. It was a flawless October for Boreham Wood and Curd, who came into the team at the start of the month. He subsequently played each of their five National League games - all of which were won – and kept two clean sheets in the process. They are already 12 points clear at the top of the table. Merrick was in the opposition goal as Boreham Wood won a dramatic game against Hartlepool 4-3 this past weekend. It was the young keeper’s second appearance of the month, following a 2-1 success against Hornchurch. Sands continues to feature regularly between the posts for Dulwich in the Isthmian Premier League, making four appearances as the south London side sit just outside the play-off positions.
news.body_zh: 十月份，切尔西的租借球员继续在欧洲和英格兰足球金字塔中发展，其中几位为临时俱乐部做出了重要贡献。我们来看看蓝军租借球员在这个月的表现，达里奥·埃苏戈、哈里森·穆雷·坎贝尔和伊什·萨缪尔斯·史密斯都是引人注目的球员。达里奥·埃苏戈在十月份斯特拉斯堡的三场比赛中均首发出场，他被部署在法甲球队的中场中央。在斯特拉斯堡 2-1 击败尼斯的比赛中，他打进了他在俱乐部的首个进球，同时他还在对阵欧洲冠军巴黎圣日耳曼的比赛中打满了 90 分钟。珍尼西斯·安特维和菲利普·乔根森继续做出了强大的贡献，两人都首发了全部三场比赛。萨缪尔斯-史密斯在诺茨郡继续着令人印象深刻的发展，在联赛一级和 EFL 奖杯赛中出场五场比赛。他在其中四场比赛中踢满了 90 分钟，包括战胜谢菲尔德星期三和诺丁汉森林 21 岁以下青年队的比赛，并在中后卫和中场左路的位置上展示了他的多才多艺。穆雷-坎贝尔（上图）在 RC Kortrijk 第一次租借到成年足球队期间仍然是后防线上的重要成员。这位20岁的球员参加了对阵亨克和标准列日的比赛，科特赖克在后者客场苦战中赢得一分。 10月，德里在葡萄牙球队客场2-0战胜朗斯的比赛中首次亮相欧洲冠军联赛。在葡萄牙联赛杯四分之一决赛中，这位边锋为里斯本竞技队2-1战胜马里迪莫队提供了助攻。威尔逊本赛季一直是罗奇代尔队的主力球员，他十月的亮点是在本月初以 1-0 战胜斯温顿镇的比赛中保持不失球。 17 岁的卡武玛-麦奎因在朴茨茅斯度过了又一个富有成效的月份，十月份参加了六场锦标赛比赛。这位年轻的边锋在3-2战胜谢菲尔德联队的比赛中表现出色，他助攻庞培拿下重要的三分。沃尔什继续在维冈竞技获得宝贵的高级经验，参加了联赛球队十月份的全部六场比赛。他在对阵哈德斯菲尔德的比赛中送出助攻，并在本月对阵雷丁和巴罗的两场胜利中首发。十月份，埃梅纳洛在凯尔特人队以 7-1 击败红心队的比赛中首次亮相。随后他又参加了与邓迪联队的平局。穆埃卡还参加了苏格兰超级联赛的全部三场比赛。萨帕耶夫在 9 月份受伤后，在 10 月份重返赛场。这位 18 岁的球员为伯恩利出场 3 次，自租借加盟英冠俱乐部以来，他的出场次数达到了 7 次。对于萨尔和皇家社会来说，这是非常好的一个月。这位后卫在六场比赛中均首发，其中四场获胜，其中三场是在西甲。这些胜利使他们在积分榜上上升至第五位。他们还客场6-0大胜利勒斯特罗姆，取得本赛季欧联杯首胜。停赛复出后，迪萨西在月底对阵纽卡斯尔和托特纳姆热刺的英超比赛中首发出场。他还在老鹰客场对阵里昂和贝西克塔斯的欧罗巴联赛中踢满了90分钟。巴迪亚什勒在那不勒斯后防线核心位置上首发了四场比赛，其中包括欧冠输给比利亚雷亚尔的比赛以及3-3战平罗马的惊心动魄的比赛。不幸的是，在那场比赛中受伤使他缺席了那不勒斯过去的两场比赛。桑切斯为科莫出场两次，先是在欧冠联赛中输给费耶诺德，然后在意甲联赛中3-1战胜都灵。十月份，加尔纳乔在维拉的比赛中得到了更多的出场机会，他在四场比赛中替补出场，其中包括在欧冠联赛中主场对阵费内巴切和维京斯塔万格的比赛。哈里森已经在温布尔登的中场站稳了脚跟，在繁忙的十月份，他在七场比赛中首发六场。在此过程中他积累了超过300分钟的足球时间。与此同时，理查兹目前因伤缺阵。基亚诺·戴尔继续为切斯特菲尔德队在二级联赛中定期出场。他为尖峰队出场五次，目前尖峰队排名第十。对于本月初加入球队的博勒姆·伍德和库德来说，这是一个完美的十月。 随后他参加了五场国家联赛的每一场比赛——全部获胜——并在此过程中保持了两场不失球。他们已经领先积分榜榜首12分。上周末，博勒姆伍德以 4-3 戏剧性地战胜了哈特尔普尔，梅里克在对手的球门中进球。这是这位年轻门将本月第二次出场，此前球队以 2-1 战胜了霍恩彻奇。桑德斯继续在地峡英超联赛中为德威队出场四次，这支南伦敦球队只在附加赛位置之外。

news.title: What kit are Chelsea wearing against Sunderland?

news.body_en: Chelsea's final game before the November international break takes us to the North-East of England to play Sunderland. The Blues head to the Stadium of Light fresh off the 2-0 success against Manchester United last weekend. We also won our most recent Premier League away game, at Everton, and another victory on Sunday will ensure we go into the last international break of 2026 in the top four. news.title: That’s Proper Chels: Chelsea FC and Chelsea Foundation unite Blues family to support those experiencing loneliness
news.title_zh: 这才是正确的切尔西：切尔西足球俱乐部和切尔西基金会联合蓝军大家庭为那些经历孤独的人提供支持
news.body_en:
Chelsea FC and Chelsea Foundation have joined forces for a third consecutive year to support the Blues' local community through the launch of That's Proper Chels. Inspired by classic Christmas shopping channels, the club's 2026 festive campaign sees a cast of familiar faces showcase the gifts, traditions and unmistakable spirit that make Chelsea unique. Underpinning the campaign is a commitment to making a positive difference. A percentage of sales from our festive range will be donated to Chelsea Foundation and its charity partners, helping to fund work that tackles loneliness and social isolation across London and the communities surrounding the club. Since we launched our first festive campaign in 2024, over £280,000 has been granted to organisations tackling homelessness and loneliness in south-west London and Surrey. Funds have come from the sale of festive products in the Stamford Bridge Megastore and online, along with monetary donations from fans, staff and the wider Chelsea community. Supporters have also donated gifts at men’s and women’s matches in the build-up to Christmas, with 3,200 presents given last year alone and distributed to those in need. This year’s campaign is centred around a nostalgic Chelsea TV network, complete with its own shopping segments, special guests and game shows. Designed to recall a time of families gathering around a TV to watch together, and an era when a shopping catalogue was diligently poured over with pages turned down to mark the much-wanted items, there are appeal messages woven throughout to highlight Christmas is a time for giving. View this post on Instagram            
Players from the men’s and women’s teams lead the campaign, with Ellie Carpenter, Cole Palmer, Morgan Rogers and Alyssa Thompson featuring. The campaign launches today across our social media channels and outdoor advertising spots across the city. There are plenty of winter classics available in the merchandise range on sale online and in store, including three designs of Christmas jumper which, based on previous years, are destined to sell out. As well as two patterns in blue, for 2026 we have a seasonal jersey taking its theme from the famous away shirt that shocked when first unveiled three decades ago, with its unmissable tangerine and graphite colouring. To also help wrap up warm, there are Christmas scarves and hats, while the 2026/27 home, away and third kits make perfect gifts for Blues fans everywhere, as does the selection of stocking-fillers we suggest. Click to see the Chelsea festive range Coming soon and a club-first, Chelsea will bring That's Proper Chels to life with a pop-up retail shop in Covent Garden, London's premier shopping destination, throughout the festive period. The store will serve as a home for all things Chelsea, offering supporters a unique Christmas shopping experience in the heart of the capital. Featuring a TV screen-inspired shop window that transports visitors directly into the world of That's Proper Chels, the pop-up will showcase and sell items from our exclusive festive range alongside products featured in the campaign launch. As supporters shop, they will also be helping to make a difference, with a percentage of proceeds from the festive collection donated to Chelsea Foundation and its charity partners to support their work tackling loneliness. Laura Cordingley, CEO Chelsea Foundation, said: ‘Christmas should be a time of connection and togetherness, but we know that for many people in our local community, it can also be a time of loneliness and isolation. At Chelsea Foundation, we believe in the power of our club to bring people together, create a sense of belonging and make a lasting difference to the lives of those around us. ‘Through the That’s Proper Chels festive campaign, profits from the Christmas range will help fund grants that can be awarded to local organisations who are working tirelessly to tackle loneliness, build connections and ensure that people feel supported, not just at Christmas, but throughout the year. ‘Every purchase can help us extend that support to those who need it most. It’s a powerful example of how, together, we can turn pride in our club into positive change in our community.’ In the build-up to Christmas, Chelsea Foundation will host its annual festive lunch at Stamford Bridge, supporting those experiencing loneliness. Supporters will have the opportunity to donate gifts similar to last year at designated drop-off points at all Stamford Bridge matches for both men’s and women's teams, from 14 November. To donate £5 to support those experiencing loneliness this Christmas, please text CFCFOUNDATION to 70085
news.body_zh:
切尔西足球俱乐部和切尔西基金会连续第三年联手，通过推出 That's Proper Chels 来支持蓝军当地社区。受经典圣诞购物频道的启发，俱乐部 2026 年节日活动中，一群熟悉的面孔展示了切尔西独一无二的礼物、传统和鲜明的精神。该活动的基础是做出积极改变的承诺。我们节日系列产品的一部分销售额将捐赠给切尔西基金会及其慈善合作伙伴，帮助资助伦敦和俱乐部周边社区解决孤独和社会孤立问题的工作。自 2024 年发起首次节日活动以来，我们已向伦敦西南部和萨里解决无家可归和孤独问题的组织捐赠了超过 28 万英镑。资金来自斯坦福桥大型商店和网上销售的节日产品，以及球迷、工作人员和更广泛的切尔西社区的捐款。支持者还在圣诞节前夕的男子和女子比赛中捐赠了礼物，仅去年一年就捐赠了 3,200 份礼物并分发给有需要的人。今年的活动以怀旧的切尔西电视网络为中心，包括自己的购物部分、特邀嘉宾和游戏节目。旨在回忆起一家人围坐在电视机前一起观看的时光，以及一个翻阅购物目录以标记急需物品的时代，贯穿其中的吸引人的信息都交织在一起，以强调圣诞节是一个给予的时刻。在 Instagram 上查看这篇文章            
男队和女队的球员领衔本次竞选，其中包括埃莉·卡彭特、科尔·帕尔默、摩根·罗杰斯和艾莉莎·汤普森。该活动今天在我们的社交媒体渠道和全市户外广告位上启动。网上和店内销售的商品系列中有大量冬季经典单品，其中包括三款圣诞套头衫，这些款式基于往年的设计，注定会售空。除了两种蓝色图案外，我们还有一款 2026 年赛季球衣，其主题源自三十年前首次亮相时令人震惊的著名客场球衣，采用了不容错过的橘子和石墨色。为了保暖，我们还提供圣诞围巾和帽子，而 2026/27 年主场、客场和第三套球衣是送给各地蓝军球迷的完美礼物，我们建议选择圣诞袜填充物。点击查看切尔西节日系列 即将推出的切尔西节日系列将在整个节日期间在伦敦首屈一指的购物胜地考文特花园开设一家快闪零售店，以俱乐部为先例，将 That's Proper Chels 融入生活。该商店将成为切尔西所有物品的聚集地，为支持者在首都市中心提供独特的圣诞购物体验。该快闪店以电视屏幕为灵感的商店橱窗将游客直接带入 That's Proper Chels 的世界，将展示和销售我们独家节日系列的商品以及活动发布中的产品。当支持者购物时，他们也将帮助改变现状，将节日系列的一部分收益捐赠给切尔西基金会及其慈善合作伙伴，以支持他们应对孤独的工作。切尔西基金会首席执行官劳拉·科丁利 (Laura Cordingley) 表示：“圣诞节应该是一个联系和团聚的时刻，但我们知道，对于我们当地社区的许多人来说，这也可能是一个孤独和孤立的时刻。在切尔西基金会，我们相信俱乐部有能力将人们聚集在一起，创造归属感，并为我们周围人的生活带来持久的改变。 “通过 That’s Proper Chels 节日活动，圣诞节系列产品的利润将有助于资助当地组织，这些组织可以不懈地努力解决孤独感、建立联系并确保人们不仅在圣诞节，而且全年都能感受到支持。” “每次购买都可以帮助我们向最需要的人提供支持。这是一个强有力的例子，说明我们可以共同将俱乐部的自豪感转化为社区的积极变化。”在圣诞节前夕，切尔西基金会将在斯坦福桥举办年度节日午餐，为那些经历孤独的人提供支持。 从 11 月 14 日起，支持者将有机会像去年一样，在斯坦福桥男女队所有比赛的指定落客点捐赠礼物。要捐赠 5 英镑来支持今年圣诞节感到孤独的人，请发送短信 CFCFOUNDATION 至 70085

news.title: Chelsea stars named in Premier League Fan Team of the Week
news.title_zh: 切尔西球星入选英超本周最佳球迷阵容
news.body_en: Chelsea's impressive 2-0 victory over Manchester United has earned the Blues further recognition, with three of our players selected in the Premier League's Official Fan Team of the Week for Matchweek 9. Estevao Willian, Romeo Lavia and Morgan Rogers have all been included in the fan-selected XI for Matchweek 9 after playing important roles in Saturday's victory over the Red Devils. The Blues returned to winning ways with an excellent display at Stamford Bridge, as second-half goals from Rogers and Cole Palmer secured all three points for Xabi Alonso's side. Rogers broke the deadlock early in the second half with a superb individual effort, collecting Lavia's pass in midfield before driving forward and finding the net. The England international's impressive attacking display earned him a place in the Team of the Week, alongside Lavia, who was instrumental in Chelsea's victory. Our No.45 produced an outstanding all-round performance in the heart of midfield, demonstrating his composure in possession, ability to break up opposition attacks and quality on the ball. The Belgian's influential display also saw him voted Player of the Match by supporters on the Chelsea Official App, before claiming the Premier League's Player of the Matchweek award. Estevao completes the Chelsea trio selected by supporters, with the Brazilian winger recognised for his lively attacking performance against United. The 19-year-old was a constant threat with his skill, movement and creativity, helping the Blues secure an important victory in front of the Stamford Bridge faithful. Chelsea's three representatives are joined by players from Arsenal, Aston Villa, Bournemouth, Brighton & Hove Albion and Tottenham Hotspur in the final XI, which was selected by supporters voting on the Premier League's official website. Premier League Official Fan Team of the Week – Matchweek 9 Goalkeeper: Bart Verbruggen (Brighton & Hove Albion). Defenders: Ezri Konsa (Arsenal), Jan Paul van Hecke (Tottenham Hotspur), Luka Vuskovic (Brighton & Hove Albion), Gabriel (Arsenal). Midfielders: Estevao Willian (Chelsea), Declan Rice (Arsenal), Roméo Lavia (Chelsea), Morgan Rogers (Chelsea). Forwards: Nicolas Jackson (Aston Villa), Evanilson (Bournemouth).

news.title: Chelsea Women vs Everton: How to watch, kick-off time, live stream info
news.title_zh: 切尔西女足 vs 埃弗顿：如何观看、开球时间、直播信息
news.body_en: We return to Stamford Bridge on Saturday afternoon when we take on Everton in the Women's Super League. The Blues are currently top of the WSL table on goal difference - sitting on equal points with Manchester City - with our tally helped by our 6-0 victory against Charlton at The Valley last time out. We now prepare to play our fifth game at the Bridge this season when the Toffees visit. Here is everything you need to know about how to watch Chelsea Women against Everton, including kick-off time and how to follow the action on official Chelsea channels. Chelsea Women's game against Everton takes place on Sunday 8 November 2026 at Stamford Bridge, with kick-off scheduled for 12.45pm UK time. The best way to see the game is to join us at the Bridge! Tickets are still available to purchase here. If you can't make the game in person,  then you can watch the action live on Sky Sports Premier League and Sky Mix. As always, team news, live updates and match coverage will be provided in our Chelsea Women vs Everton Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and Chelsea website. You can also follow along via Chelsea Women’s social media channels on X, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok. After drawing with Aston Villa in our first league game of the campaign, the Blues have since won seven WSL games in a row. This is our best winning streak in the same top-flight season since winning our first nine matches under head coach Sonia Bompastor in 2024/25. We have scored 18 goals across our last four WSL games, netting three times twice and six times twice. The Toffees are eighth in the table after eight games. They have kept three clean sheets this season, only one fewer than they managed across the whole of the 2025/26 campaign (four in 22). Chelsea (five) are the only other side with more than two shutouts in the competition this term. Chelsea have won 16 of our last 18 WSL games against Everton (one draw and one defeat), netting three or more goals in 11 of our last 12 victories. Everton were 1-0 winners in this fixture at Kingsmeadow last season, ending a run of eight consecutive away defeats against Chelsea in the Women’s Super League. The Toffees have never won back-to-back WSL away matches versus the Blues.
news.body_zh: 周六下午我们将返回斯坦福桥，在女子超级联赛中迎战埃弗顿。蓝军目前在 WSL 积分榜上以净胜球优势位居榜首，与曼城积分相同，上一场比赛我们在山谷球场以 6-0 战胜查尔顿，帮助我们取得了进球。我们现在准备在太妃糖队来访时打本赛季在大桥的第五场比赛。以下是您需要了解的有关如何观看切尔西女足对阵埃弗顿的所有信息，包括开球时间以及如何关注切尔西官方频道的比赛。切尔西女足对阵埃弗顿的比赛将于 2026 年 11 月 8 日星期日在斯坦福桥举行，开球时间定于英国时间中午 12 点 45 分。观看比赛的最佳方式就是来到桥上加入我们！门票仍然可以在这里购买。如果您无法亲自观看比赛，则可以在天空体育超级联赛和 Sky Mix 上观看比赛直播。与往常一样，球队新闻、实时更新和比赛报道将在切尔西官方应用程序和切尔西网站上的切尔西女足对阵埃弗顿比赛中心提供。您还可以通过 X、Facebook、Instagram 和 TikTok 上的 Chelsea Women 社交媒体渠道进行关注。在本赛季第一场联赛中与阿斯顿维拉战平后，蓝军已经连续赢得了七场 WSL 比赛。这是我们自 2024/25 年在主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 的带领下赢得前九场比赛以来，在同一顶级联赛赛季中取得的最佳连胜纪录。在过去的四场 WSL 比赛中，我们打进了 18 个进球，分别进了 3 球、2 球和 6 球。八场比赛过后，太妃糖队排名第八。他们本赛季保持了三场不失球，仅比他们在2025/26赛季整个赛季的表现（22场比赛中的四场）少一场。切尔西（五场）是本赛季唯一一支在比赛中被淘汰两次以上的球队。切尔西在过去 18 场对阵埃弗顿的 WSL 比赛中赢了 16 场（1 平 1 负），在过去 12 场胜利中有 11 场打入 3 个或更多进球。上赛季埃弗顿在金斯梅多的这场比赛中以1-0获胜，结束了女超联赛客场对切尔西的八连败。太妃糖队从未在 WSL 客场对阵蓝军的比赛中连续获胜。

news.title: UEFA Youth League report: Cobham Next Gen 2-3 Flora Tallinn (4-5 aggregate)
news.title_zh: 欧足联青年联赛报告：科巴姆下一代 2-3 弗洛拉塔林（总比分 4-5）
news.body_en: Chelsea Cobham Next Gen exited the UEFA Youth League after a 3-2 defeat to Flora Tallinn. We went ahead within two minutes of both halves but a late penalty sent us out of the competition. Mathis Eboue gave us an early lead with a low, driven finish into the far corner, but Sander Alamaa equalised shortly afterwards, making it 1-1 at half-time. In the second half, we began in similar fashion with Ibrahim Rabbaj putting us back in front with his second touch after coming off the bench. Unfortunately, Flora responded quickly again, this time through Marten Kukkonen. They later took the lead from the penalty spot through Alamaa, ending our European aspirations this term. Flora enjoyed a fast start in the reverse fixture, but today it was Chelsea who set the tone immediately, going ahead within two minutes. Yisa Alao lofted the ball up to Ezenwata who nodded it into the path of Eboue. The Blues winger initially stood up his marker before dropping a shoulder, going down the line and rifling his shot against the post and into the bottom corner. Our lead didn’t last long as Alamaa, who scored a brace in the first leg, pickpocketed Alfie Osborne and went through on goal to equalise. We enjoyed the better chances of the first half and neared our second of the afternoon when Ezenwata played a driven pass across the face of goal. Eboue met it first but miskicked his shot, and the ball subsequently fell to Alao, whose effort was snuffed out by Andero Tatrik. At the interval, the score remained level both on the afternoon and on aggregate. Rabbaj was introduced in the second half, replacing Osborne, and made an instant impact. Eboue proved a threat again down the left wing and cut back towards the penalty spot, where Rabbaj was waiting to tuck home with only his second touch. Unfortunately, Flora got back on level terms eight minutes later through Kukkonen. In the 69th minute, Grimwade picked up the ball on the edge of the box surrounded; he wriggled in and out, dodging at least three Flora defenders, before aiming for the top corner - but his effort sailed just over. Flora Tallinn won a penalty with 12 minutes remaining, which was converted by Alamaa to put the visitors in front. Eboue tried to provide the response, when he cut inside and went for the spectacular, but his strike was off target. Andrew Pennie was played through with limited minutes left on the clock, his shot was hard and low but denied by Flora. There were five minutes of additional time and we pushed for an equaliser, but we couldn’t find the all-important goal. This defeat spells the end of our involvement in this season's UEFA Youth League. Cobham Next Gen visit London rivals Tottenham Hotspur this Sunday at the Lamex Stadium. The game gets underway at 1pm GMT and supporters can watch the match live with a CFC+ subscription. Chelsea (4-3-3): Freddy Bernal; Yisa Alao, Olutayo Subuloye (c), Alfie Osborne (Ibrahim Rabbaj 46), Calvin Diakite (Jacob Hall 87); Heze Grimwade (Jashayde Greenwood 80), Reggie Watson, Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli; Sol Gordon (Riley Ebho 81), Chizaram Ezenwata, Mathis Eboue (Andrew Pennie 81)Unused subs: Toby Bell, Gabriel Sambou, Isago Silva, Josh HenryScorers: Eboue 2, Rabbaj 47Booked: Ezenwata 36, Alao 38, Watson 59Manager: Harry Hudson Flora Tallinn (4-1-4-1): Andero Tatrik; Patrick Pihlak (Risto Raudsalu 88), Ronald Sammul, Joosep Palts (c) Nikita Kalmokov (Karel Isok 46); Jaron Silm (Eerik Paltser 68); Denis Zotov (Ron Neltsas 69), Marten Kukkonen, Remo Valdmets, Sander Alamaa; Karl-Tristen Lorenz (Uku Korjus 77)Unused subs: Ron Sebastian Miss, Mark Kukk , Jaan Erik Poldma, Rocco OjaScorers: Alamaa 17, 78, Kukkonen 54Booked: Zotov 4, Lorenz 60, Neltsas 72, Raudsalu 90+3 Manager: Alstaar Andris
news.body_zh: 切尔西科巴姆下一代在以 3-2 输给弗洛拉塔林后退出欧洲青年联赛。上半场两分钟后我们就取得了领先，但最后时刻的点球让我们退出了比赛。马西斯·埃布埃 (Mathis Eboue) 的一记低射远角为我们取得领先，但桑德·阿拉马 (Sander Alamaa) 不久后扳平比分，半场结束时比分变为 1-1。下半场，我们以类似的方式开始，易卜拉欣·拉巴伊替补出场后的第二次触球让我们重新领先。不幸的是，弗洛拉再次迅速做出了反应，这次是通过马丁·库科宁。随后他们通过阿拉马点球取得领先，结束了我们本赛季的欧洲之旅。弗洛拉在相反的比赛中取得了快速的开局，但今天是切尔西立即定下了基调，在两分钟内取得了领先。伊萨·阿拉奥 (Yisa Alao) 将球传给埃森瓦塔 (Ezenwata)，埃森瓦塔 (Ezenwata) 将球点到了埃布埃 (Eboue) 的路线上。这位蓝军边锋一开始站了起来，然后肩膀一沉，沿着底线将球射向门柱，飞入球门底角。我们的领先优势并没有持续太久，首回合梅开二度的阿拉马在扒窃阿尔菲·奥斯本后射门扳平比分。我们享受了上半场更好的机会，并在接近下午的第二场比赛时，Ezenwata 将球传过球门。埃布埃先接球，但射门失误，球随后传给了阿拉奥，后者的射门被安德罗·塔特里克扑出。中场休息期间，下午的比分和总比分都保持持平。下半场拉巴伊替换奥斯本上场，并立即发挥作用。埃布埃在左翼再次证明了威胁，并切向点球点，拉巴伊正在等待第二次触球得分。不幸的是，八分钟后弗洛拉通过库科宁扳平了比分。第69分钟，格里姆韦德禁区边缘得球；他蠕动着进进出出，躲开了至少三名弗洛拉防守队员，然后瞄准了球顶角——但他的射门稍稍高出。弗洛拉·塔林在比赛还剩 12 分钟时赢得点球，阿拉马主罚命中，客队取得领先。埃布埃试图做出回应，他内切并打出精彩的射门，但他的射门偏离了目标。安德鲁·彭尼在比赛还剩有限的时间时，他的射门又硬又低，但被弗洛拉挡出。补时还有五分钟，我们力争扳平比分，但我们没能找到最重要的进球。这场失利意味着我们本赛季青年欧洲联赛的结束。科巴姆下一代将在本周日在美时球场客场挑战伦敦对手托特纳姆热刺队。比赛于格林威治标准时间下午 1 点开始，支持者可以通过 CFC+ 订阅观看比赛直播。切尔西（4-3-3）：弗雷迪·伯纳尔； Yisa Alao、Olutayo Subuloye (c)、Alfie Osborne (Ibrahim Rabbaj 46)、Calvin Diakite (Jacob Hall 87)；赫泽·格里姆韦德（Jashayde Greenwood 80）、雷吉·沃森、迈赫迪·尼科尔-贾祖利；索尔·戈登（莱利·埃博 81）、奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔、马蒂斯·埃布埃（安德鲁·彭尼 81）未上场替补：托比·贝尔、加布里埃尔·桑布、伊萨戈·席尔瓦、约什·亨利得分：埃布埃 2、拉巴杰 47 黄牌：埃森瓦塔 36、阿劳 38、沃森 59 经理：哈里·哈德森 弗洛拉·塔林(4-1-4-1)：安德罗·塔特里克； Patrick Pihlak (Risto Raudsalu 88)、Ronald Sammul、Joosep Palts (c) Nikita Kalmokov (Karel Isok 46)；杰伦·席尔姆（Eerik Paltser 68）； Denis Zotov（Ron Neltsas 69）、Marten Kukkonen、Remo Valdmets、Sander Alamaa；卡尔-特里斯坦·洛伦茨 (Uku Korjus 77) 未上场替补：罗恩·塞巴斯蒂安·米斯、马克·库克、贾恩·埃里克·波尔德马、罗科·奥哈得分：阿拉马 17、78、库科宁 54 黄牌：佐托夫 4、洛伦茨 60、内尔察斯 72、劳德萨鲁 90+3 经理：阿尔斯塔尔·安德里斯
